messages.content:
You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Hello, honey, this is Gloria Hart. I have an appointment with Dr. Patel on Tuesday, and I need to move it to later that week.
AGENT: Hi Gloria, I'd be happy to help you reschedule that appointment. Let me first verify your information so I can access your account. What's your date of birth?
CALLER: Of course, honey. It's May 12th, 1947.
AGENT: Thank you. And just to confirm, can I get your address or phone number?
CALLER: Oh dear, I'm not sure I have that with me right now, honey. Could we use something else?
AGENT: That's okay, Gloria. Let me try with what we have. I'll verify your account with your name and date of birth. Perfect, Gloria. Now let me pull up your appointments to find that Tuesday appointment with Dr. Patel. I found your appointment with Dr. Patel on Tuesday, September 29th at ten in the morning. You'd like to move it to later that week—would Thursday, October 1st work for you, or did you have a different day in mind?  [system actions: verify_identity, list_appointments]
CALLER: Thursday afternoon would be best, honey, if you have it.
AGENT (LATEST): Let me search for available slots with Dr. Patel on Thursday afternoon. Great news! Dr. Patel has two afternoon slots on Thursday, October 1st: two o'clock or three twenty. Which would you prefer?  [system actions: find_slots]

CONDITIONS:
move_1: the agent offers one or more Thursday afternoon times
move_2: the agent first reads back or confirms the new appointment time
stop_0: Agent has confirmed the new Thursday time and that the Tuesday appointment is cancelled.
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.

message.content: {"move_1": {"met": true, "why": "Agent offered 2:00 and 3:20 Thursday slots"}, "move_2": {"met": false, "why": "No specific time confirmed yet, still asking preference"}, "stop_0": {"met": false, "why": "No confirmation of new time or cancellation yet"}, "emergency": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of 911 or emergency services"}}
